interactions.assay: in vivo assay · pathogen burden after challenge after adoptive transfer
interactions.note: Administration of the epitope-specific SARS2-02  or SARS2-55 mAb prevented weight loss due to SARS-CoV-2 virus infection. MAb treatment resulted decreased viral RNA levels in the nasal washes and lung relative to controls on 7 dpi and decreased infectious virus levels in the lung. Cytokine and chemokine levels in the lung were also reduced. Therapeutic treatment with hSARS2-02 at 24 h post-infection also protected against weight loss following infection and at 7 dpi, hSARS2-02 reduced viral RNA levels in the lung and heart by ~10,000-fold.

interactions.assay: in vivo assay · decreased disease after adoptive transfer
interactions.note: Administration of the epitope-specific SARS2-02 mAb prevented weight loss due to infection with chimeric SARS-CoV-2 virus containing the spike protein of variant B.1.351. However, mAb treatment did not significantly decrease viral RNA levels in the nasal washes, lung, heart or brain relative to controls when administered 24 h before or 24 h after infection.
